# Dholera Smart City Land & Investment Intelligence (DholeraPlatform)
> DholeraPlatform (https://www.dholeraplatform.com) is the premier independent real estate intelligence, town planning analysis, and verified land investment advisory platform for Dholera Special Investment Region (SIR), Gujarat, India.

## Core Intelligence & Navigation
- [Town Planning Scheme Maps](https://www.dholeraplatform.com/tp-maps): Interactive high-resolution cadastral boundaries, sector layouts, and zoning demarcations for TP1, TP2, TP3, and TP4.
- [Plotted Projects Showcase](https://www.dholeraplatform.com/projects): Curated, Collector Non-Agricultural (NA) certified residential villa townships and commercial plotted schemes.
- [Smart Infrastructure Tracker](https://www.dholeraplatform.com/infrastructure): Ground reality updates on the 109 km Ahmedabad-Dholera Expressway, Dholera International Airport at Navagam, and subterranean plug-and-play utility ducts.
- [Investor Guide & Due Diligence](https://www.dholeraplatform.com/invest): Institutional acquisition protocols, Town Planning Form F reconstitution checks, 30-year revenue title search guidelines, and NRI FEMA regulations.
- [Market Updates & Blog](https://www.dholeraplatform.com/blogs): Daily market intelligence, verified TP scheme rate matrices, and infrastructure progress analyses.

## Real Estate Fundamentals in Dholera SIR
- **Statutory Authority**: Supervised by Dholera Special Investment Region Development Authority (DSIRDA) and Dholera Industrial City Development Limited (DICDL).
- **Zoning & Clear Titles**: Properties featured adhere strictly to Section 65 Collector NA orders, verified Gujarat Revenue 7/12 land records, and reconstituted Final Plot (FP) status under Gujarat Town Planning and Urban Development Act (GTPUDA).
- **Major Anchor Catalysts**: ₹91,526-crore Tata Electronics Semiconductor Mega Fab in TP2, Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) rail feeder lines, Dholera Solar Park (5,000 MW), and the 4-lane access-controlled expressway to Ahmedabad.

## Key Investment Corridors & Benchmark Rates (2026)
- **TP1 Residential Core**: ₹12,500 – ₹19,500 per sq. yard (Gated NA villa and society plots).
- **TP2 High-Density Commercial**: ₹18,500 – ₹29,000 per sq. yard (Corporate, retail, and mixed-use).
- **TP2 Industrial Corridor**: ₹9,500 – ₹16,500 per sq. yard (Clean tech, electronics, and engineering).
- **Expressway Frontage Ribbon**: ₹23,000 – ₹35,000 per sq. yard (Logistics parks, commercial hubs, high-FSI).
